title: Bank account and payment concern
when: Applies when the report concerns an account, a payment, credentials, or an unfamiliar debit.
thisOrganisation: Assess the reported concern with a human reviewer. Do not promise to freeze an account or refund money.
otherOrganisation: A telecom handover is allowed only when the report also includes a suspicious SMS or phone call. Otherwise no telecom handover.
humanJudgement: A person must review the account and payment concern before any action is taken.

title: Suspicious SMS or phone call
when: Applies when the report concerns a suspicious SMS, text message, or phone call.
thisOrganisation: Assess the reported messages with a human reviewer. Do not infer SIM swapping. Do not assume the provider sent the message.
otherOrganisation: A bank handover is allowed only when the report also includes an account or payment concern. Otherwise no bank handover.
humanJudgement: A person must review the message details before any service action is taken.

title: Human support and limited information
when: Applies when the person reports pressure or urgency, or when the information is not enough to identify a concern.
thisOrganisation: Offer human support. Do not generate an organisation handover.
otherOrganisation: No organisation handover is generated from this guideline.
humanJudgement: A person speaks with the affected person and agrees the next step.

title: Supplier email payment change
when: Applies when a supplier sends changed payment details by email.
thisOrganisation: Assess the payment and check the change through an existing contact before acting.
otherOrganisation: Do not generate a telecom handover when the report has no SMS or phone call.
humanJudgement: A person must verify the payment and the supplier details before any action is taken.
